name: pocket-squad
description: A lean Claude Code workflow in your pocket: /ps:init (CLAUDE.md + PRODUCT.md + ARCHITECTURE.md), /ps:story (refine → .squad/stories), /ps:load + /ps:run (warm worktree + PR per task), /ps:review (fresh eyes, two parallel lenses), /ps:publish (squash-merge + sweep + learnings), /ps:pipe (the whole story, unattended).
